result_summary: For every centered nonsingular indefinite three-dimensional Gaussian quadratic form, the density is continuous and its global maximum occurs at zero. If the whitened coefficient magnitudes are a<=b and c, then p(0)=K(k)/(pi sqrt(b(a+c))) with k^2=(b-a)c/[b(a+c)], and p(0)<=1/(2[ab(a+c)(b+c)]^(1/4)). Consequently Sigma>=v0 I and min|eig A|>=s imply ||p||inf<=1/(2sqrt(2)v0s). If additionally |det A|>=s^3(1+delta), 0<=delta<=1, then ||p||inf<=1/(2v0s sqrt(2+delta)). The cap-one variance floor v0=1/12 makes 3sqrt(2) the exact centered-Gaussian rank-three ceiling.

partner_result_applied.application: For partner spectrum {1,1,-(1+1/m)}, the centered isotropic Gaussian comparator has exact global norm 6/sqrt(2+1/m)<3sqrt(2). Reparameterizing the partner finite fragmented witness by alpha=1-exp(-3theta) gives C_*>=3sqrt(2)(1-alpha)>4 with limiting satellite probability alpha for 0<alpha<1-4/(3sqrt(2)).
